authority: OPS5 on-demand planning, not rehabilitation implementation

stages.title: Archive and validate three owner packages
stages.deliverable: Archive hashes and contents manifest; confirm 4 DOCX and 54 PNG; all drawings labeled non-S3
acceptance: Archive hashes and contents manifest; confirm 4 DOCX and 54 PNG; all drawings labeled non-S3
Every claim has a source HEAD or attached-package SHA and explicit S0/S1/S2/S3/S4 grade
One relevant negative case has an observed rejection or is recorded as a live external blocker
stages.negative_case: Corrupt ZIP, wrong internal digest, missing manifest

stages.title: Pin source, PR and candidate versions
stages.deliverable: App frozen baseline and current PR881/882/883 snapshots; all changed heads and old exports recorded
acceptance: App frozen baseline and current PR881/882/883 snapshots; all changed heads and old exports recorded
Every claim has a source HEAD or attached-package SHA and explicit S0/S1/S2/S3/S4 grade
One relevant negative case has an observed rejection or is recorded as a live external blocker
stages.negative_case: Moving head, stale export or unmerged candidate mislabeled shipped

stages.title: Complete all-file, system, behavior and showcase coverage
stages.deliverable: Reconcile all 276 system units, 5,213 source paths and all discovered feature families; every unclassified path and missing standalone engine gets one triage decision. Preserve 60 original showcases and 16 supplemental scope reviews.
acceptance: Reconcile all 276 system units, 5,213 source paths and all discovered feature families; every unclassified path and missing standalone engine gets one triage decision. Preserve 60 original showcases and 16 supplemental scope reviews.
Original CQR1/2/3 review-unit and track allocations unchanged.
No route map is a claim that behavior was executed or owner reviewed.
stages.negative_case: Unassigned path, duplicate system, unreviewed behavior or synthetic S3

stages.title: Normalize historic and local findings
stages.deliverable: All 58 root plus 46+27+19 track entries retained with exact original IDs, severity, witnesses, limitations and 3 binding owner art rejections
acceptance: All 58 root plus 46+27+19 track entries retained with exact original IDs, severity, witnesses, limitations and 3 binding owner art rejections
Every claim has a source HEAD or attached-package SHA and explicit S0/S1/S2/S3/S4 grade
One relevant negative case has an observed rejection or is recorded as a live external blocker
stages.negative_case: Lost ID, inflated exploit claim, owner decision overwritten

stages.title: Adjudicate duplicate causes and cross-consumer links
stages.deliverable: Every record tagged SAME_CAUSE/RELATED_DISTINCT/SHARED_CONTRACT/INDEPENDENT/UNRESOLVED, backed by exact source and test comparison
acceptance: Every record tagged SAME_CAUSE/RELATED_DISTINCT/SHARED_CONTRACT/INDEPENDENT/UNRESOLVED, backed by exact source and test comparison
Every claim has a source HEAD or attached-package SHA and explicit S0/S1/S2/S3/S4 grade
One relevant negative case has an observed rejection or is recorded as a live external blocker
stages.negative_case: String-match-only dedupe, changed candidate or dropped negative test

stages.title: Rank risk and version-scoped user impact
stages.deliverable: Privacy, data loss, gameplay canon, visual, UX, accessibility, availability and installed/synthetic certainty separately ranked
acceptance: Privacy, data loss, gameplay canon, visual, UX, accessibility, availability and installed/synthetic certainty separately ranked
Every claim has a source HEAD or attached-package SHA and explicit S0/S1/S2/S3/S4 grade
One relevant negative case has an observed rejection or is recorded as a live external blocker
stages.negative_case: Source-only condition described as real breach, art rejection marked accepted

stages.title: Capture genuine S3 app outputs or document blocked features
stages.deliverable: Baseline 60 current-app capabilities genuinely rendered or precisely blocked; 16 supplemental demonstrations specified. Do not require a missing system to pass S3 before authorized repairs.
acceptance: Baseline 60 current-app capabilities genuinely rendered or precisely blocked; 16 supplemental demonstrations specified. Do not require a missing system to pass S3 before authorized repairs.
Screenshots are from actual compiled feature code, never from descriptive reports.
A missing/unsupported engine is a logged rehabilitation issue and remains S3 open.
stages.negative_case: AI picture, infographic or storyboard credited as app screenshot

stages.title: Record owner S4 judgments on exact shown candidates
stages.deliverable: Owner feedback on exact existing output where shown, preserving three art rejections and keeping unavailable feature S4 open for post-repair per-group review.
acceptance: Owner feedback on exact existing output where shown, preserving three art rejections and keeping unavailable feature S4 open for post-repair per-group review.
Each S4 binds exact code/art SHA and is not inferred from test status.
stages.negative_case: No owner response, changed asset/build, missing S3 treated as pass

stages.title: Map root causes, domain authority and RHB dependency DAG
stages.deliverable: Design 44 independently owned feature groups; prioritize standalone test app and UI before visual consumer acceptance, while source-only engines can advance under separately approved work items.
acceptance: Design 44 independently owned feature groups; prioritize standalone test app and UI before visual consumer acceptance, while source-only engines can advance under separately approved work items.
No group can silently modify another group's owner API or invent generic rendered output.
stages.negative_case: Two writers for same durable state, circular dependency, unauthorized provider change

stages.title: Decompose RHB into testable corrective child tranches
stages.deliverable: Decompose all 44 groups into bounded corrective and G0–G5 repair/standalone render/owner review/app integration loops. Preserve all 150 finding aliases and 76 visual/functional appraisal obligations.
acceptance: Decompose all 44 groups into bounded corrective and G0–G5 repair/standalone render/owner review/app integration loops. Preserve all 150 finding aliases and 76 visual/functional appraisal obligations.
Every group has a real executable lab requirement or exact missing capability case.
No group certifies itself on tests alone.
stages.negative_case: Unassigned problem, untestable task, missing migration or visual proof

stages.title: Set execution waves, resources and governance guards
stages.deliverable: Plan first F02 test-host/F01 UI wave, versioned independent group interfaces, native device and licensed-asset proof, finances/resources and exact-head OPS5 publication.
acceptance: Plan first F02 test-host/F01 UI wave, versioned independent group interfaces, native device and licensed-asset proof, finances/resources and exact-head OPS5 publication.
No implicit budget or existing implementation-lane reassignment.
stages.negative_case: Unavailable device assumed, provider selected without approval, unsafe concurrent branches

stages.title: Final three-review closure and OPS5 start handoff
stages.deliverable: After complete three-track discovery, all 276 units and 5,213 files dispositioned, 150+ source records reconciled, 76 original+supplemental showcase status known and 44 group corrective cycles owner-approved, hand off a separate first-UI execution selection.
acceptance: After complete three-track discovery, all 276 units and 5,213 files dispositioned, 150+ source records reconciled, 76 original+supplemental showcase status known and 44 group corrective cycles owner-approved, hand off a separate first-UI execution selection.
RHB groups remain UNSTARTED until separately authorized; no premature review closure.
stages.negative_case: Review still open, owner verdict missing, unapproved budget or branch drift

review_termination_gate: Only owner-confirmed complete three-track issue intake, all 60 actual S3 or owner-approved known-missing exceptions, distinct root causes assigned to implementation-ready RHB child work, then owner go/no-go and a fresh OPS5 selector publication.
